Hi Finance Team,

I am currently traveling between client sites and have limited access to the main ERP portal. We have an urgent settlement due today for Apex Procurement Ltd (INV-84920) totalling £14,500.00.

Since this exceeds the single-signoff limit, I have initiated the preliminary review on my end. Could one of you please complete the secondary approval via the secure AP portal link below so the payment run is not delayed?

[SIMULATED LINK: Secure AP Portal Approval - ap.example-corp-sim.local/auth/invoice/84920]

Let me know once processed.

Regards,

Arthur Pendelton
Director of Finance
Apex Professional Services Ltd
